note: Replaces the 'twitter' entry of capabilities.json ONLY while the X service is configured (X_SERVICE_URL + X_SERVICE_API_KEY). Every supported action names the X API operation it maps to and has a handler in social/x_engine.js — tests/x-engine.test.js fails if the two ever drift. Without the X service the base manifest applies unchanged.

search.notes: Recent search: posts from roughly the last 7 days.

view_profile.returns: display name, bio, followers, following, post count, join date

view_posts.returns: an account's recent posts: URL, text, date

view_feed.returns: her home timeline, newest first: URL, author, text

comment.notes: On X, commenting on a post is replying to it.

reply.notes: A reply on X is the same operation as a comment on the post.

follow.notes: A protected account answers 'pending' until it approves.

connect.reason: Connection requests are a LinkedIn concept; X has no equivalent action.

dm.notes: One message to one person. No bulk.

read_dms.notes: Reads her real inbox, so it always asks her creator first.

post.notes: Text only — media upload is not part of this integration.

notifications.notes: Mentions only — X's API has no notifications tab, so likes, follows and reposts are not included.

delete_post.notes: Her own posts only; it refuses anything else without calling X.

delete_comment.notes: Her own replies only; it refuses anything else without calling X.
